keyFindings.description: A session upgrading from the core path (no consumer snapshot) registers with no resume; the listener creates s-<id> at the stream's end (session_delivery.go:199-208, session_consumers.go:812-814) and setConsumerMode(true) makes sweepOnce return before any /v1/replay read (replay.ts:771), so every agent and issue message stored while it was away is lost with no notice. Same in claude-envoy (restoreReplay -> openRelay with snapshot.consumer undefined).

The serving-port relay applies only echo and capability refusals; it skips the (dedupe key, session) dedupe and attempt caches fanoutDelivery applies (delivery.go:901-920), so an OpenCode session following a repo gets one prompt_async per mention copy (normalize.go publishes pr.N.mention, mention and the comment topic under one key).

A serving-port session's first consumer starts at the stream's end, yet takesStoredMessagesItself makes the durable path and the serve-port worker ack every redelivered message for it, including ones stored below the consumer's OptStartSeq: lost at the transition.
ErrForwardNotStored adds a refusal at the publish/send boundary (delivered -> delivery_failed when the stream gives no PubAck); the PR body carries no ## Contract change census.
Production always sets servePorts, roleForwards and relay (main.go:904-910, 960-966); the nil branches (inline push, inline forward, relayed false state) run only in tests.
Relay lifecycle (takeDeliveryAnswer, persistRelay, relaysCoreTopic, closeRelay) duplicated in claude-envoy; the H1 fix would land twice. Move into @legion/envoy-client/consumer-delivery.
cachedFirstRoleClaims picks cache vs bucket by a call counter and returns a partial RoleClaim.
pushUntilAccepted duplicates serve_port_workers.go pushUntilSettled's backoff loop and fanoutDelivery's refusals; the dedupe gap above is the cost.
replay.delivered check appears unreachable after consumer-delivery's alreadyWritten in the same synchronous step.
SubscribeResult.delivery optional though every caller maps absence to core.
Security[transport] hardening: role lane pending limits off; a publisher flood grows listener memory without bound.
A CONSUMER_STATE_ENTRY with the whole follows map is appended per written frame.
